test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 2: USER ACCOUNT RECOVERY SCENARIO
test_cases.test_case_title: Initiate Password Reset from Login Modal
test_cases.pre_condition: The system is online and accessible. A user (Teacher or Student) is on the 'Landing Page' and the 'Login Modal' is open.
test_cases.expected_result: The system displays a form requesting the user to enter their registered email address for password recovery.
test_cases.post_condition: The password reset email request form is displayed.

test_steps.step: Click the 'Login' button on the 'Landing Page' to open the Login Modal.
Click the 'Forgot Password?' link within the Login Modal.
